title: Fraud Penalty Weeks on Benefit Overpayment Accounts — Training Bulletin
content:
A fraud determination on Benefit Overpayment Accounts also imposes the classification's penalty weeks, recorded on the determination as its penalty weeks. Otherwise-payable weeks the claimant certifies on any claim are denied, one penalty week at a time, until all penalty weeks are served. Non-fraud classifications impose no penalty weeks.

## Questions answered

**Which weeks serve a penalty week?** Only otherwise-payable weeks the claimant certifies, on any claim, within the disqualification window years after the determination date. Penalty weeks are not served by weeks that would not have been payable anyway.

**What happens to penalty weeks not served within the window?** They lapse.

**Do penalty weeks reduce the claim balance?** No. They never reduce the claim balance.

**Does a non-fraud overpayment carry penalty weeks?** No.

## Worked case (hypothetical)

A fraud determination imposes 3 penalty weeks. The claimant then certifies four weeks within the window: week 1 otherwise payable, week 2 not payable because the claimant was not available for work, weeks 3 and 4 otherwise payable.

| Week | Otherwise payable | Result | Penalty weeks still to serve |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Yes | Denied, serves one penalty week | 2 |
| 2 | No | Not payable anyway; serves none | 2 |
| 3 | Yes | Denied, serves one penalty week | 1 |
| 4 | Yes | Denied, serves one penalty week | 0 |
